summary: Oncolytics Biotech filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 furnishing a press release dated October 20, 2026, announcing a trial-in-progress abstract and e-poster for the REO 033 study to be presented at the ESMO Congress 2026. REO 033 is a randomized Phase 2 study of pelareorep plus FOLFIRI/bevacizumab versus standard of care in second-line RAS-mutant, MSS metastatic colorectal cancer. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. This is an ordinary clinical disclosure, not a special situation; monitor trial enrollment and any future regulatory interactions as the clinical catalyst.
